milestones.title: AI Engineering Foundation
milestones.outcome: Mandatory discovery, constrained workflows, deterministic tests, and source-bound evidence.

packages.title: Session discovery instructions
packages.implementation: Root discovery instructions and the VS Code instruction bridge are in place.

evidence.note: Mandatory discovery sequence and trust boundary.

packages.title: Capability schema and registry validation
packages.implementation: Strict capability manifests, completeness checks, and dependency validation are implemented.

evidence.note: Strict manifest schema.
Registry and invalid-manifest regression coverage.

packages.title: Discovery, inventory, explain, and session verification
packages.implementation: The CLI scans capabilities and issues exact-task and registry-bound receipts.

evidence.note: Implemented discovery and registry commands.
Receipt matching and invalidation tests.

packages.title: Specialist roles and mandatory behaviors
packages.implementation: Specialist ownership and mandatory engineering behaviors are registered.

evidence.note: Role boundaries.
Mandatory safety, validation, and documentation behaviors.

packages.title: Constrained workflow runner and signed evidence
packages.implementation: The runner enforces closed inputs, command allowlists, artifact-only writes, and signed source-bound evidence.

evidence.note: Workflow execution and evidence verification.
Workflow policy, tamper, and source-integrity coverage.

packages.title: Pinned toolchain, regression tests, and CI definition
packages.implementation: The native Node test suite, pinned dependencies, and Windows/Linux CI workflow are defined.

evidence.note: Pinned package manager and dependencies.
Cross-platform foundation CI definition; hosted execution is tracked separately.

packages.title: Sample workflow
packages.implementation: The foundation workflow is exercised against isolated committed test repositories.

evidence.note: Clean committed fixture completes and verifies the workflow.

milestones.title: Incremental Roku MCP integration
milestones.outcome: Pinned read-only tooling inspection and safe, evidence-backed device workflows without weakening M0.

packages.title: Baseline gap assessment
packages.implementation: The existing foundation was assessed and Roku MCP gaps were recorded without recreating M0.

evidence.note: Incremental gap matrix and acceptance boundary.

packages.title: Pinned SDK and editor configuration
packages.implementation: Tooling is pinned and both repository MCP configurations use editor-specific formats and workspace-relative paths.

evidence.note: VS Code stdio configuration.
Second editor configuration; editor discovery/callability remains unobserved.
Configuration validity and failure tests.

blockers: Editor-client connectivity and physical-device compatibility have not been verified.

packages.title: Official SDK skill registration
packages.implementation: Generated Roku SDK skills are present at their prescribed locations without divergent edits.

evidence.note: Official skills are registered.
Vendor notice retained.

packages.title: SDK and MCP availability observations
packages.implementation: Discovery records static SDK/config/context observations and the local tooling probe has observed 80 advertised tools; callability and editor access are not inferred.

evidence.note: Closed, normalized availability observations.
Generated status summary from this roadmap.

packages.title: Bounded inspection and device adapter
packages.implementation: Bounded read-only stdio inspection and pure policy helpers exist; no device-control adapter or operation surface is wired.

evidence.note: Read-only protocol inspection.
Policy helpers are not runtime enforcement.
Fake-transport and policy regression coverage.

blockers: An authorized, policy-enforced device adapter remains unimplemented.

packages.title: Runtime device leases and authorization
packages.implementation: Pure target/lease/authorization helpers are not connected to atomic runtime lease storage or an authorized adapter.

evidence.note: Non-wired policy helpers only.

blockers: Implement and test exclusive runtime leases, authorization enforcement, and uncertain-operation reconciliation before enabling controls.

packages.title: Setup and device-smoke workflows
packages.implementation: The read-only setup-inspection workflow exists; an authorized physical smoke workflow does not.

evidence.note: Setup workflow and offline gates.
Setup scope and physical verification blockers.

blockers: Device smoke must wait for runtime authorization/leases, an adapter, and approved hardware access.

packages.title: Device evidence schema and aggregation
packages.implementation: A strict schema and always-blocked physical-evidence record are integrated into setup runs; real device evidence collection is not implemented.

evidence.note: Evidence shape and integrity constraints.
Setup runs bind blocked device evidence to source and commit.

blockers: Physical device evidence collection requires the authorized adapter and smoke workflow.

packages.title: Authorized physical smoke
packages.implementation: No physical smoke test has been run or reported as passed.

evidence.note: Physical verification remains blocked; no device check was claimed.

blockers: No verified named Roku target, model/OS, developer mode, maintenance window, or sideload-slot approval is recorded.

packages.title: Runbooks, ADR, and CI
packages.implementation: The transport/security ADR, setup runbook, gap assessment, and offline CI definition exist.

evidence.note: Inspection-only transport and trust-boundary decision.
Reproducible setup and recovery instructions.
Offline-capable CI workflow definition.

blockers: Hosted CI execution and cross-platform parity have not been observed.

milestones.title: Roku Mock Prototype
milestones.outcome: A native sideloaded mock Roku app with remote navigation, verified on the target device.

packages.title: Verify hardware, OS, SDK, and sideload
packages.implementation: Target-device compatibility and a minimal-app sideload have not been verified.

evidence.note: Generated prerequisites and blocked state.

blockers: Obtain authorized access to a named Roku and verify model, OS, developer mode, and sideload prerequisites.

packages.title: Scaffold the native Roku app
packages.implementation: No native Roku application is implemented; the browser preview is a separate mock.

evidence.note: Generated status distinguishes the browser preview from a Roku app.

blockers: Wait for the hardware/SDK compatibility gate before choosing or scaffolding the client.

packages.title: Design components and focus/navigation
packages.implementation: Native app design system, components, and focus manager are not started.

packages.title: Implement mock-backed Roku screens
packages.implementation: Native Home, Movies, Series, Search, and Details screens are not started.

evidence.note: Browser-only mock preview exists but does not satisfy this package.

packages.title: Build/deploy scripts and remote tests
packages.implementation: Native build/deploy scripts and remote navigation tests are not implemented.

packages.title: Run authorized device smoke
packages.implementation: No native startup/navigation/focus smoke or current-commit device evidence exists.
blockers: Requires the M0-RK safety layer and authorized, compatible Roku hardware.

milestones.title: Playable MVP
milestones.outcome: A Roku client that browses and plays existing Jellyfin content with shared watch state.

packages.title: Experience API and contracts
packages.implementation: A loopback NestJS API foundation serves sample preview data and authenticated catalog and favorites; the browser preview connects through a loopback proxy. Playback is unavailable.

evidence.note: Initial versioned routes; playback explicitly unavailable.
Offline route, authentication and preview proxy tests.
Browser preview proxy and mock interaction tests.

blockers: Complete OpenAPI contracts, pagination, production security review and M1 device acceptance remain outstanding.

packages.title: Jellyfin library and artwork adapter
packages.implementation: A scoped Jellyfin adapter supports initial catalog and favorite requests with a default loopback mock upstream; connecting a real server requires explicit live mode. Artwork proxying is not implemented.

evidence.note: Initial adapter; live Jellyfin compatibility remains unverified.
Default simulated upstream, not a real Jellyfin implementation.
Offline upstream request, mock catalog, favorites and error coverage.

blockers: Artwork and live Jellyfin compatibility remain unverified.

packages.title: Device pairing and credential lifecycle
packages.implementation: The API and CLI initialize a per-user device database; owner-generated single-use codes and revocable credentials support local pairing, including a browser preview with an in-memory credential.

evidence.note: Automatic database initialization, SQLite pairing and revocation.
Offline first launch, pairing, expiry, persistence and revocation checks.

blockers: Windows ACLs, secure remote transport and native-device pairing remain unverified.

packages.title: Playback, progress, and resume
packages.implementation: Playback endpoints explicitly return 501; negotiation, progress, resume, and completion are not implemented.

evidence.note: Unavailable routes fail explicitly rather than simulating playback.

packages.title: Real-device playback compatibility
packages.implementation: No Direct Play or transcoding behavior has been tested on a Roku.

packages.title: Playback and focus audits
packages.implementation: No device focus/playback audit journeys are implemented.

milestones.title: Autonomous Catalog
milestones.outcome: Authorized, validated media enters Jellyfin through durable catalog jobs.

packages.title: Metadata discovery and normalization
packages.implementation: Metadata discovery adapters are not implemented.

packages.title: Household ranking and policies
packages.implementation: Ranking and catalog policy are not implemented.

packages.title: Authorized acquisition adapters
packages.implementation: No acquisition adapters or authorization policy are implemented.

packages.title: Media validation and reconciliation
packages.implementation: Media validation, quarantine, import, and Jellyfin reconciliation are not implemented.

packages.title: Durable scheduler and audit log
packages.implementation: Durable scheduling, bounded retries, and audit history are not implemented.

milestones.title: Self-Maintaining Platform
milestones.outcome: Observable, backed-up Windows services with safe dry-run retention.

packages.title: Storage budget and retention simulation
packages.implementation: Storage budgeting and retention simulation are not implemented.

packages.title: Dry-run cleanup safeguards
packages.implementation: Cleanup remains unimplemented; deletion must stay disabled and dry-run by default.

packages.title: Health, backup, and restore drills
packages.implementation: Health reporting, backups, and restore drills are not implemented.

packages.title: Windows service deployment and rollback
packages.implementation: Windows service installation and rollback are not implemented.

packages.title: Explicitly approved retirement enablement
packages.implementation: Automated retirement is not enabled or implemented.

nextActions.action: Design and test the narrowest approved device adapter while preserving the inspection-only boundary.
Implement atomic exclusive leases and explicit authorization before exposing device controls.
Add the authorized device-smoke workflow only after adapter and lease enforcement are testable.
Collect the approved Roku model/OS, developer-mode, and sideload prerequisites; keep hardware claims blocked until observed.
